Committee Consideration and Mark-up Session Held
Referred to the House Committee on Science, Space, and Technology.

dimensions.assessment: Affects energy companies, researchers, academic institutions, national laboratories, and communities near pipeline infrastructure.
dimensions.evidence: eligible entities... an institution of higher education... a nonprofit research organization; a National Laboratory... a private commercial entity

dimensions.assessment: Establishes structured demonstration initiatives and joint research programs to advance pipeline safety and technology.
dimensions.evidence: carry out demonstration projects on low- to mid-technology readiness level subjects to achieve deployment of technologies

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes specific funding amounts, including $45 million in FY 2026 and $50 million annually for FY 2027-2030 for demonstration initiatives, plus additional funding for joint programs and NIST metrology.
dimensions.evidence: authorized to be appropriated to the Secretary of Energy to carry out this section $45,000,000 for fiscal year 2026, and $50,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2027 through 2030.

dimensions.assessment: Establishes multiple new programs, a National Pipeline Modernization Center, joint research programs, and interagency memoranda of understanding.
dimensions.evidence: establish a National Pipeline Modernization Center... establish within the Department a joint research and development program

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes programs and funding through fiscal year 2030, with specific statutory sunset provisions after five years for certain sections.
dimensions.evidence: This section shall terminate five years after the date of the enactment of this section.

importance_detail.rationale: The bill authorizes multi-million dollar annual appropriations across fiscal years 2026 through 2030 for pipeline research, development, demonstration initiatives, joint agency programs, and a National Pipeline Modernization Center.
